$comment: Base Data Commons theme — the blue one Google plans to launch first. Every value here is a theme token; no base-DC branch exists in component code. Colours are from the 'UI elements branded elements - Data Commons' spec slide, which names #0B57D0 (Google product blue) as primary, #EFEDED for skeleton bars and #F5FAFF for the skeleton surface; the rest were sampled from the accompanying mockups. The empty `navigation` array is deliberate — the spec calls for removing the base-DC header menu from the Narratives App altogether, not restyling it.
